MIDDLE EAST

🇵🇸 West Bank – Israeli raid in Nablus leaves 1 dead, 4 wounded amid ongoing counterterror operations.

🇬🇿 Gaza Strip – U.S. preparing to shut down military-run Gaza mission following stalled ceasefire and aid efforts.
🇮🇷 Iran – Strait of Hormuz tensions rising as U.S. prepares operation to assist stranded vessels amid conflict spillover.

⸻

AFRICA

🇲🇦 Morocco – Two U.S. service members reported missing during African Lion exercise near Tan-Tan.

⸻

INDO-PACIFIC

🇵🇭 Philippines – U.S. and Philippine forces conduct live-fire and drone-integrated operations during Balikatan exercise.
🇨🇳 China – Advanced stealth UAVs observed at secretive test base, indicating continued expansion of high-end ISR capabilities.

⸻

MARITIME / TRANSNATIONAL

🌊 Caribbean / Eastern Pacific – Ongoing U.S. military strikes against suspected narcotics trafficking vessels continue under counternarcotics mission.

⸻

UNITED STATES (FORCES & GLOBAL POSTURE)

🇺🇸 United States – Pentagon accelerates AI integration across classified networks via multiple commercial partnerships.
🇺🇸 United States – USS Higgins suffers propulsion and power loss due to engineering casualty while deployed Indo-Pacific.

⸻

GLOBAL DEFENSE & TECHNOLOGY

🌐 Defense Industry – U.S. Navy expands AI-enabled mine countermeasure capabilities targeting Iranian maritime threats.
🇮🇱 Israel – Procurement of additional F-15IA and F-35I squadrons signals sustained high-tempo operational planning.
